notes.title: Eat my Shuriken and Die!
notes.content:
About a month ago we received an unexpected fan email for the original Eat my Shuriken and Die! on Xbox360. We're very grateful for those kind words and it inspired us to revisit the Steam PC port and see if we could complete it!

Said and done, and during one of the many review passes with Steam -another- fan message arrived out of the blue. Now we really wanted to get this old nostalgic gem released.

We're happy to announce that this week we finally passed review and the game is finally available for PC! With Steams "Remote Play Together" it should even be possible to enjoy 4-player mayhem remotely, even though the game only supports local multiplayer. We'd love to hear some feedback on how well this works.

The PC port supports using the keyboard in addition to the Xbox, PS4 and some USB gamepads. Find the key mapping on our homepage: https://www.flowersfx.com/

Cheers!
